preconditions.description: The number of balls in the first player's box is between 1 and 50.
The number of balls in the second player's box is between 1 and 50.
The maximum number of balls the first player can take in one move is between 1 and 50.
The maximum number of balls the second player can take in one move is between 1 and 50.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'First' if (n_1 > 0 and n_2 > 0) else return_value == 'Second'
postconditions.description: The first player wins if both boxes have balls initially; otherwise, the second player wins.
